source_authority: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) — State Agricultural Universities (includes state veterinary, horticulture and fisheries universities)
cross_reference: Every row is matched to a row of UGC's live State Universities list (research/official_lists/ugc/ugc_state_universities.json, ugc_id). kind is derived from the name.

not_included_here.central_agricultural_universities: CAU Imphal, Dr. RPCAU Pusa and RLBCAU Jhansi are central (UGC central list; ICAR page /en/node/17302); loaded in C1/C4.

notes: ICAR's page prints 'Orissa', 'UttraKhand', 'Jammu & Kashmir'; states are normalised to UGC spelling. The asterisk on row 17 has no footnote on the page. Names are kept verbatim (including ICAR's typos) in name_as_listed; prefer ugc_name for display after review.
